newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telefonica raised to buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities analyst Joanne Showalter has raised her rating for Telefonica de Espana to buy from market performer.
-- The upgrade was prompted by Telefonica's alliance with British Telecommunications Plc and MCI Communications Corp, Showalter wrote in an April 21 report.
-- "We believe that Telefonica is likely to undergo a continued multiple expansion, and as such, we are raising our rating ...," she said.

-- Showalter raised her price target to $90 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) from $71 "based on a conservative multiple to gross cash flow of 4.2x our 1998 forecasts versus current levels of 3.4x."
-- The company's ADRs were up 1-1/8 to 76-3/4.
